mapper.select: SELECT CASE refund_status WHEN '0' THEN '待审核' WHEN '1' THEN '审核通过' WHEN '2' THEN '退款中' WHEN '3' THEN '已完成' WHEN '4' THEN '已驳回' END AS name, COUNT(id) AS value FROM order_refund GROUP BY refund_status

SELECT COUNT(id) AS totalRefundCount, COALESCE(SUM(refund_amount), 0) AS totalRefundAmount, CASE WHEN COUNT(id) = 0 THEN 0 ELSE ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN refund_status = '3' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(id), 2) END AS refundCompleteRatio FROM order_refund
